# trove

> Public-domain U.S. healthcare data, parsed and documented: FDA novel drug approvals (1985–2025) with labels, approval letters and review documents, and nonprofit hospital charity care as reported to the IRS (Form 990 Schedule H) and to CMS (Medicare cost report Worksheet S-10). Open source, MIT-licensed, built by Chris Betz. Not medical, legal or financial advice.

Every figure on the site comes from a named federal source and links back to it. Data files are under https://troveproject.com/data/ and can be read directly over HTTPS (CSV, JSON, Parquet). Pages listed below as .md are Markdown versions of the HTML pages.

## FDA drug approvals

- [FDA drug approvals: list and lookup](https://troveproject.com/drugs/): 1,387 CDER novel approvals by year, 1985–2025, and a page for each of 217 novel approvals from 2021–2024
- [FDA drug approval statistics, 1985–2025](https://troveproject.com/drugs/statistics/index.md): approvals per year, NDA and BLA counts, priority review, orphan, accelerated approval, breakthrough and fast track counts, receipt-to-approval times
- [FDA NME compilation as CSV and Parquet](https://troveproject.com/drugs/compilation/index.md): FDA's Compilation of CDER NME and New Biologic Approvals, converted from Excel, with column definitions
- Per-year lists: [2025](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2025/index.md) [2024](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2024/index.md) [2023](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2023/index.md) [2022](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2022/index.md) [2021](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2021/index.md) [2020](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2020/index.md) [2019](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2019/index.md) [2018](https://troveproject.com/drugs/2018/index.md) (pattern: https://troveproject.com/drugs/YYYY/index.md, 1985 onward)
- Per-drug pages: https://troveproject.com/drugs/<brand-name>/index.md, for example [Filsuvez](https://troveproject.com/drugs/filsuvez/index.md), [Casgevy](https://troveproject.com/drugs/casgevy/index.md), [Leqembi](https://troveproject.com/drugs/leqembi/index.md). Each gives the approval date, application number, sponsor, review designation and links to the FDA label, approval letter, review documents and Drug Trials Snapshot

## Hospital charity care (IRS and CMS)

- [Hospital charity care: the IRS figure and the CMS figure, side by side](https://troveproject.com/hospitals/): lookup of 2,099 matched nonprofit hospital systems, tax year 2022
- [Note: what is in the difference between the two figures](https://troveproject.com/notes/charity-care-gap/): method, a worked reconciliation for one hospital, and the largest differences

## Explainers

- [What is an FDA novel drug approval?](https://troveproject.com/docs/fda-nme/)
- [What is a new molecular entity (NME)? NME vs NCE](https://troveproject.com/docs/new-molecular-entity/)
- [What is an FDA approval package? Approval letter, reviews, Summary Basis of Approval](https://troveproject.com/docs/fda-approval-package/)
- [What is an FDA Drug Trials Snapshot?](https://troveproject.com/docs/drug-trials-snapshot/)
- [What is HCRIS? CMS Medicare Cost Reports](https://troveproject.com/docs/hcris/)
- [What is IRS Form 990 Schedule H? Parts, line 7a and the instructions](https://troveproject.com/docs/schedule-h/)

## Data files

- [fda_approvals_nme_recent.json](https://troveproject.com/data/fda_approvals_nme_recent.json): 217 FDA novel approvals, one object per drug, with document URLs and review designations (also .parquet)
- [fda_nme_compilation.csv](https://troveproject.com/data/fda_nme_compilation.csv): 1,387 CDER novel approvals, 1985–2025 (also .parquet)
- [community_benefit_gap_2022.csv](https://troveproject.com/data/community_benefit_gap_2022.csv): IRS Schedule H line 7a and CMS S-10 line 23 for matched hospital systems, tax year 2022 (also .json, .parquet)
- [charity_care_gap_index_2022.json](https://troveproject.com/data/charity_care_gap_index_2022.json): the ranked index of single-facility hospitals

## Optional

- [Claude Code skills](https://troveproject.com/skills/): fda-analyst and hcris-analyst answer questions over these datasets
- [Source code](https://github.com/cbetz/trove): parsers, build scripts and tests
- [Sitemap](https://troveproject.com/sitemap.xml)
